verdict.rationale: Rippling offers a developer platform with APIs across HR, IT, and finance, a sandbox, developer documentation with an llms.txt file, and an official CLI for building integrations. It also handles onboarding and automatic payroll tax calculation and filing, but the evidence shows these only as product features, not as API operations. Nothing shows an agent can create an employee, set compensation, or configure tax withholding through the API end-to-end. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for creating employees, setting compensation and tax setup, evidence these write operations are open to third-party or agent callers, and hands-on corroboration of an API-driven onboarding flow.
